image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a large marine mammal surfacing in blue water. The visible portion shows the dorsal side of the animal, featuring dark grey, mottled skin with lighter speckling consistent with barnacles or cyamids. A series of low, rounded humps (dorsal knuckles) runs along the posterior back instead of a distinct dorsal fin. Water splashes and foam surround the body.
